Hello and welcome to this week’s Sunday Summary!

We had quite a number of new stories and awesome prompts in the past few days as well as some people who decided to drop by and are now camping here with their tents, kettles, and writing utensils. We even had our subverse mentioned in the Reddit drama posts more than a couple of times, although I’m not entirely sure if that’s a good thing. There is no such thing as bad press though, I guess.

As for the awesome people that have been writing and posting stuff here this week, I would like to thank @ZapptheBrannigan with his three new stories, @Googlygoink with an awesome saga (you guys should totally check it out, I’m slowly going through it and it’s great), and @milkshake, @Sento_Fernner, @PikachuInTheShower, @rosanna, @Caboose_Calloway, @escapefromredditbay, @bakalaka, @Psychosexual, and @WannabePoet for the prompt replies. Special thanks also goes to @oaken for the top-rated image prompt this week. I would also like to apologize if I missed anyone here (I can be forgetful sometimes), so you can leave a comment IN CAPS AND BOLD LETTERS WITH A LOT OF ANGRY EXCLAMATION MARKS, saying that I have forgotten to put your name in.

In other news, for those who are just joining us now or have simply not heard of this before, we have created our very own IRC channel on the BaphoNet network. It’s called #writerslounge, and is actually pretty active, especially in the evenings. I myself was there until about 1:30 last night because @gr33narrow and the folks decided that I can’t just go and sleep. Barely made it out. Going there again tonight. You can find the link to the main Voat chat channel in the sidebar, and to join Writers’ Lounge from there all you have to do is simply type /join #writerslounge in the text field.

We have also just unveiled the Challenge Prompts which will be updated several times a week. @gr33narrow had just posted our first CP… hmm, Challenge Prompt, Fantasy Setting, so make sure to check it out.

I would also like to thank our kind benefactor and the creator of this verse, @SurvivorType, and wish him a happy Father’s Day. Honestly, although he might not want it, he now has a small writers’ family, and we will go through with the Father’s Day tradition. There. Have a card, ST. Have another card. And then another.

And to everyone else - keep on writing and keep being awesome.

Oh, and since .self posts do not leave you a notification that your name was mentioned (and I just want to fill your inbox), I will now draw a large circle on the ground and summon @ZapptheBrannigan, @Googlygoink, @milkshake, @Sento_Fernner, @PikachuInTheShower, @rosanna, @Caboose_Calloway, @escapefromredditbay, @bakalaka, @Psychosexual, @WannabePoet, @oaken, @gr33narrow, and @SurvivorType. Enjoy.
